title: Video upload · auto model switching · disable Gemini 2.5 for video attachments
description:
- Added video upload support in Aurora chat input
- Auto-detect video attachments and switch from Gemini 2.5 to 3.1 models
- Disable Flash 2.5 and Pro 2.5 options when video is attached
- Dynamic placeholder for Aurora (video) vs Thomas (image)
- Visual indicators with tooltips for disabled models
